_comment: Copy this file to theme.json to customize the catalog's appearance. The build script injects these values into index.html at build time.

colors._comment: Use any valid CSS color: hex (#ff0000), rgb(255,0,0), or named colors (red).

fonts._comment: Any Google Fonts family name works. display_font is used for titles and headings. body_font is used for general text. mono_font is used for labels and metadata.
